title: Gaussian process regression
description: introduces non-parametric Bayesian regression.

title: Gaussian process classification
description: *extends* Gaussian process regression to classification scenarios.

title: Dirichlet process mixture models
description: extends the Bayesian mixture to the infinite case, i.e. when we don't know the number of clusters beforehand. We use the *Chinese restaurant process* and the *stick-breaking construction* for inference..

title: SBC
description: shows a method to validate Bayesian posterior inferences.

title: Structure MCMC
description: shows how `PyMC3` can be used to learn the structure of a Bayesian network.

title: Mixed models
description: shows concise reference implementations for optimization of the objective of (generalized) linear mixed models.

title: Sequential regression models
description: introduces a special class of ordinal regression models which assume a sequential response mechanism.

title: Causal structure learning using VAEs
description: implements a novel graph variational autoencoder and compares it to *greedy equivalence search*, one of the state-of-the-art methods for causal discovery.

title: Normalizing flows
description: shows how TensorFlow Probability can be used to implement a custom normalizing flow.

title: Bayesian optimization
description: introduces the basics of optimization of costly to evaluate functions with probabilistic surrogate models.

title: Hierarchical, coregionalized GPs
description: implements two GP models and compares their predictive performance as well as MCMC diagnostics on an US election data set.

title: Variational LSTMs
description: implements a variational multivariate LSTM for timeseries prediction of an US election data set.

title: Hilbert-space approximate copula processes
description: explains how a copula process in conjunction with Hilbert-space approximations can be used to model stochastic volatility.

title: VI for stick-breaking constructions
description: implements mean-field variational approximations for nonparametric mixture and factor models using stick-breaking constructions.

title: Tensor-product spline smoothers
description: implements a probabilistic model for causal inference with structured latent confounders.

title: Normalizing flows for variational inference
description: implements an *inverse autoregressive flow* for variational inference of parameters in a simple bivariate Gaussian example in Jax, Distrax, Optax and Haiku.

title: Diffusion models I
description: introduces a novel class of generative models that are inspired by non-equilibrium thermodynamics.

title: Probabilistic reconciliation
description: implements and tests two recent methods on reconciliation of hierarchical time series forecasts.

title: Diffusion models II
description: introduces a new class of generative models using stochastic differential equations and denoising score matching.

title: Reverse-mode autodiff in Clojure
description: a proof-of-concept autodiff engine built to learn Clojure.

title: Blaxbird v0.2.0
description: sharding NNX models over an arbitrary mesh.

title: Learning MLX
description: learning Apple's array framework MLX by implementing a compute-heavy ABC sampler.

title: What is DiffusionGemma?
description: on architecture, noise schedule, training and inference.
